title: A pawn becomes a queen
summary: A pawn that reaches the last row becomes a new piece.

steps.md: Magic time! When a pawn reaches the **last row**, it turns into a queen, rook, bishop or knight.
One more step and this pawn becomes a queen!

steps.prompt: Push the pawn and choose a **queen**!
steps.hint: Push to the top, then pick the queen.

steps.question: A pawn reaches the end. What do players pick most?
steps.explain: The queen, because she is the strongest.

steps.prompt: Race your pawn to the end! The black king will try to catch it.
